mapper.sql: id, username, display_name, email, password_hash, last_login_at, profile_picture_url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE username LIKE #{query} OR display_name LIKE #{query} OR email LIKE #{query} ORDER BY username LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, display_name, email, password_hash, profile_picture_url) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{profilePictureUrl})
